intent: Fix CWSP-crx snip (select & recognize) pipeline and restore popup (actions) design.
lastDone: Root cause of broken popup design: @scope(:root[data-crx-page=popup]) — inner :root/html selectors never match (scope rules apply to descendants only); theme tokens never applied. Replaced token declarations with :scope (popup/index.scss)

Popup 'Rectangle Capture' was dead: globalThis.close() destroyed the popup context before its setTimeout(100ms) relay could send crx-snip-select-rect. Popup now sends crx-snip-screen-select to the SW, SW drives select→capture→process after the popup closes (popup/index.ts, sw.ts)
captureVisibleTab has no rect param — rect was silently ignored (full-window screenshots recognized). Added OffscreenCanvas crop in sw.ts captureScreenArea and service/api.ts captureVisibleTab
Rect-selector readiness: one 100ms wait lost the race on slow pages (dynamic import after document_start); now polls up to 2s (content/main.ts)
Overlay SoT (subsystem/boot/overlay.ts): showSelection now forces pointer-events:auto when showPopover fails (overlay visible but mouse-dead before); hideSelection clears the fallback
Rebuilt dist (v1.0.4); tsc crx errors unchanged vs baseline (10 pre-existing @types/chrome drift errors, Vite build unaffected)
next: Load unpacked dist/ in Chrome and verify: popup dark theme renders, Rectangle Capture shows selector after popup closes, recognize receives only the selected rect.
